description: This file implements libevent-based integration for QUIC, including classes and functions for managing socket events, alarms, and event loops within the quic namespace.

classes.name: LibeventAlarm
classes.description: Represents a QUIC alarm integrated with libevent, managing timing and firing of alarm events.

classes.name: LibeventQuicEventLoop
classes.description: Implements a libevent-based event loop for QUIC, managing socket registration, event dispatching, and alarms.

classes.name: LibeventQuicEventLoop::Registration
classes.description: Handles registration and notification of socket events within the event loop.

classes.name: QuicLibeventEventLoopFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of the libevent-based QUIC event loop.

classes.name: LibeventQuicEventLoopWithOwnership
classes.description: Provides creation of event loop instances with ownership semantics, supporting configuration options.

methods.name: LibeventAlarm::SetImpl
methods.description: Sets the alarm to fire at the specified deadline.

methods.name: LibeventQuicEventLoop::RegisterSocket
methods.description: Registers a socket with the event loop for specified events.

methods.name: LibeventQuicEventLoop::UnregisterSocket
methods.description: Unregisters a socket from the event loop.

methods.name: LibeventQuicEventLoop::RearmSocket
methods.description: Rearms a socket with new event interests.

methods.name: LibeventQuicEventLoop::ArtificiallyNotifyEvent
methods.description: Manually triggers a socket event notification.

methods.name: LibeventQuicEventLoop::RunEventLoopOnce
methods.description: Runs the event loop once with a specified timeout.

methods.name: LibeventQuicEventLoop::AlarmFactory::CreateAlarm
methods.description: Creates a new alarm associated with the event loop.

methods.name: QuicLibeventEventLoopFactory::QuicLibeventEventLoopFactory
methods.description: Constructor for the factory creating libevent-based event loops.

methods.name: LibeventQuicEventLoopWithOwnership::Create
methods.description: Creates an event loop instance with configuration options, including forced level-triggered mode.
